Title: PhoneGap support for Azure Mobile services

Body.Content: A new integrated PhoneGap Quick Start in the Azure management portal makes developing cross-platform mobile apps with PhoneGap and Azure Mobile Services easier. Check out the Getting Started with Mobile Services for PhoneGap tutorial to learn more.
Body.Markdown:
A new integrated PhoneGap Quick Start in the Azure management portal makes developing cross-platform mobile apps with PhoneGap and Azure Mobile Services easier.

Check out the Getting Started with Mobile Services for PhoneGap tutorial to learn more.
